(rule!
 ;; Each green(3) object takes the color of the KEY cell sitting just above
 ;; its bbox top-left corner.
 (for/fold ((out g)) ((obj (in-list (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 3))
                                            (objects g 0)))))
   (let* ((bb (obj-bbox obj))
          (key (at g (- (first bb) 1) (second bb))))
     (paint-cells out (obj-cells obj) key))))

(rule!
 ;; Each green(3) object takes the color of the KEY cell sitting just above

 (for/fold ((out g)) ((obj (in-list (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 3))

   (let* ((bb (obj-bbox obj))

     (paint-cells out (obj-cells obj) key))))

(rule!
  (let* ((greens
          (filter (lambda (obj) (= (obj-color obj) 3))
                  (objects g 0)))
         (largest
          (first
           (sort greens (lambda (a b) (> (obj-size a) (obj-size b))))))
         (selector-bbox (obj-bbox largest))
         (target-size
          (at g (- (first selector-bbox) 1) (second selector-bbox))))
    (for/fold ((out g)) ((obj (in-list greens)))
      (if (= (obj-size obj) target-size)
          (let* ((bb (obj-bbox obj))
                 (key (at g (- (first bb) 1) (second bb))))
            (paint-cells out (obj-cells obj) key))
          out))))
